action_items.text: Work on questionnaires and summaries regarding the current project status.
Work on individual tasks (components, user interface concepts, and design look).
Research and determine the specific chips needed for the remote's components.
Research and determine how to power the remote (chips, power sources).
Develop a simple user interface concept with a minimal number of buttons.
Research and decide on a specific look/design for the remote.
Research trends in mobile phone shapes to inform remote design.
Research trends to gather new information for the next meeting.
Work on the components (chips, power sources) for the rounded, two-piece remote design.
Explore the possibility of a two-piece remote design (one for quick zapping, one for hand fit).
Work on how the two-piece remote concepts will work with the user.

decisions.text: The remote will be designed specifically for television use, not as a universal remote.
The remote must incorporate the corporate slogan 'We put the fashion in electronics'.
The remote must use the corporate colors grey and yellow (with black as an option).
Speech recognition will be removed from the project as it is not worth the investment at this time.
The remote should feature a locator function (beep) to help find it when lost.
The remote should utilize rechargeable batteries or solar power.
The remote should be designed to fit in the hand (one-handed operation).
The remote design should be a variation of a rectangle rather than a ball shape.
The remote should be designed primarily for right-handed users.
The remote will feature a scrolling wheel/button for navigation and a click function to verify selections.
The remote will have a bulge at the bottom to improve ergonomics and house batteries.
The remote will feature buttons of varying sizes, with more important buttons being larger.
The remote will feature a sliding mechanism to hide lesser-used functions.
The project will proceed with a two-piece remote design: a larger base unit and a smaller 'zapping' device.
The larger unit will house the full functions, while the smaller unit will only have channel up/down, volume, and on/off.
The larger unit of the two-piece design will be sufficiently heavy to prevent it from rolling off surfaces.
